title: Spring 2027 · Insulated & Glass drinkware
brief:
# Spring 2027 'Fresh Air' drinkware collection

Soft pastels, matte powder coat, outdoor & on-the-go.

- Food-contact compliance: FDA + LFGB test reports required (hard requirement); BPA-free lids
- 18/8 (304) stainless steel for insulated items (hard requirement)
- Dishwasher-safe lids preferred
- Goods in our DC by 2027-03-15 for a 2027-04-01 launch

Please reply, for each product you propose, with: design & photos, material, capacity, lid type, FOB unit price & currency, MOQ (total and per colour), production lead time, sample time & cost, payment terms, port of loading, and certifications (FDA, LFGB, Prop 65).

brief_items.name: Insulated tumbler 30-40 oz
brief_items.requirements: 30-40 oz, 18/8 (304) stainless double-wall vacuum (hard requirement); straw or flip lid, leak-resistant; matte pastel colours; FDA + LFGB (hard requirement). Retail $34.

brief_items.name: Glass cup 16 oz with lid & straw
brief_items.requirements: 14-20 oz glass cup with lid and straw; FDA + LFGB (hard requirement); clear or tinted. Retail $18.
